entry.title: New: Bill 10 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 22, ARTICLE 3, DIVISION 2, SECTION 22-3.3.2, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO ALLOWABLE AREAS FOR SPECIAL ACTIVITY PERMITS

Allows for authorized commercial activities to be conducted at the following area in Kona: “Ane Keohokālole Highway, makai side, between the West Hawai‘i Civic Center and the ‘Allied Quarry’ access road.”

Latest action: Council: Bill 10, Draft 2 passes second & final reading - 03/19/2025
